0x0009D5.en: 「With my current skills...@ this is as far as I go...!」

0x000ACE.en: 「Damn it!@ You won't get me next time!」

0x000BF7.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000D33.en: 「No way I'm losing here...!@ This is no fun...」

0x000D87.en: 「I blew it...!@ Nothing to do but pull out...」

0x000E71.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000ED8.en: 「This is as far as I go... The rest is up to you.」

0x000F84.en: 「No good, we took too much... I'm pulling back!」

0x000FD1.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x00100F.en: 「Kyaa! I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x001056.en: 「To think the Granzon... could be shot down...」

0x001101.en: 「Guh... So I'm the one who becomes a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x001180.en: 「Th-this is as far as I can go...!」

0x0011F9.en: 「Well ain't that somethin', they got me good!」

0x00123D.en: 「U... ngh! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x0012AA.en: 「Guh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0012F1.en: 「I'm sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x001326.en: 「Damn it! Is this all the strength I've got...!」

0x001412.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@　I'm still green...!」

0x001460.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x00151B.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x001588.en: 「Well now, so this is where it ends.」

0x0015B7.en: 「I can't take any more. I'll be taking my leave.」

0x001642.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll pull back here...!」

0x0017A8.en: 「Ejecting...@　Guh...! Not exactly graceful, is it...」

0x001866.en: 「Guuuh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001AAA.en: 「Guess I've no choice but to fall back...!」

0x001B04.en: 「Captain, we've established contact with the rear units.@　They report that Meridenplum has been destroyed, but...」

0x001B8A.en: 「Right after, the skies over the Antarctic were also@　swallowed up by Baral's barrier.」

0x001BE9.en: 「So without meaning to, we ended up@　lending a hand to their goal...@　What's Baral doing?」

0x001C64.en: 「After wiping out the remaining Ruina units,@　they vanished.」

0x001CBA.en: 「...Eita, any reading from the Cross Gate?」

0x001CFE.en: 「The high-energy reading is still pronounced.@　But no sign of anything@　emerging from the gate.」

0x001DEE.en: 「We learned it from Joshua's group's transmission...@　She went with Ventos, too...」

0x001EF7.en: 「I'm... right here, like this.@　Even if Chris is gone,@　Cliana Rimskaya still exists...」

0x001F99.en: 「So Chris is alive too.@　That's what she said... that we'd meet again...@　And Ven surely will too...」

0x002054.en: 「Riana... you and Chris are both precious family to me.@　No matter what happens, that won't change.@　And Dad, surely...」

0x0020F9.en: 「Yeah...@　There was pain, and things I hated, but...@　Father was kind to us...」

0x002196.en: 「I'm still here too, and so is Fabularis.@　And your Sympatia as well...」

0x002201.en: 「Which means the things that serve as the "key"@　still exist on this side... and so does the "gate."」

0x002275.en: 「...I know. But there's still something@　I have to do with this thing...」

0x002302.en: 「The obstacles standing in the way of us living on@　are still out there...」

0x00237A.en: 「Yeah.@　I'll seal this thing away after we've freed@　the Earth from those people.」

0x0023E0.en: 「So you mean to fight, Joshua.@　Then I'll go too...」

0x002436.en: 「...We defeated Perfectio,@　but the Cross Gate didn't vanish.@　If anything, it's still functioning...」

0x0024D2.en: 「What in the world is that thing...」

0x0024F7.en: 「It may not be something@　the ancients built.」

0x00254D.en: 「You're saying the Cross Gate was a mystery@　even to them?」

0x0025AF.en: 「Yeah... That thing was here from the start,@ and the ancients came from within it somehow,@ but could never return to where they were.」

0x002691.en: 「And as they searched for a way back to their@　world, they learned of the Ruina's existence.」

0x002705.en: 「They waged war against them, and from what they gained@　they created the Sympatia and the Race Arcana...」

0x002794.en: 「And further, to seal the Cross Gate,@　they built this Fabula Foresta.」

0x002808.en: 「And so, though they stopped the "King of Ruin"@　from appearing at the last moment... the price was@　their own destruction.」

0x0028A8.en: 「Hey, there's something that doesn't sit right with me...@　Why didn't those guys just destroy the@　Cross Gate itself?」

0x002950.en: 「If the exit was gone,@　the "King of Ruin" couldn't come out.」

0x0029B5.en: 「The first conceivable reason is...@　that they meant to eventually pass through the@　Cross Gate and return to their own world.」

0x002A58.en: 「Then couldn't they just dive into the gate@　and be done with it, nya?」

0x002AB4.en: 「It probably wasn't a sure road...@　Like the old Shadow Mirror, many may have vanished@　before ever reaching another world.」

0x002B7A.en: 「The second conceivable reason is...@　that destroying the Cross Gate would bring@　an even greater calamity.」

0x002C23.en: 「Likely one on par with the "King of Ruin."」

0x002C57.en: （In that world too,@　I never heard of anyone@　destroying the Cross Gate...）

0x002CC9.en: 「So then, we've got no choice but to@　leave the thing alone...?」

0x002D5D.en: 「Destroying it here and now isn't wise.@　We'll need to investigate under heightened alert.」

0x002DE6.en: 「But Baral's Garden sits right@　over our heads, after all...」

0x002E4B.en: 「Yes.@　I'll contact the rear units and ask them to guard this place.」

0x002EA1.en: 「...In the end, we never did figure out why the@　Cross Gate looked so familiar to us.」

0x002F15.en: 「Yeah, a lot of mysteries remain.@　Like why the Cross Gate activated@　at this particular moment...」

0x002F9C.en: 「That's 'cause the "King of Ruin" came out, isn't it?」

0x003004.en: 「The other factor Perfectio mentioned...@　You mean the Sympatia upgrade plan@　brought by Alteur Steinbeck?」

0x0030C1.en: 「If I recall, it was an application@　of the <T-LINK System>...」

0x003116.en: 「Lieutenant Aya, do you know anything about that?」

0x00317E.en: 「...Even if Alteur got hold of T-LINK System@　data through illegal means...」

0x00320D.en: 「Why go beyond just upgrading the Sympatia and build in something to trigger the Cross Gate's activation...? That's what bothers me.」

0x0032CA.en: 「The Gaia Sabers were developing and testing@ all kinds of new weapons. Maybe something like that@ just happened to come out right by chance?」

0x00337E.en: 「By chance, huh. That's possible too, but...」

0x0033B2.en: 「Either way, Alteur is dead.@　No point digging into it now.」

0x0034A5.en: 「Yeah... To think that girl had such power...@　I keep wondering if it's connected to Baral...」

0x003534.en: 「She disappeared from our side and went to Baral...@　Maybe that girl and Custos are...」

0x0035C0.en: 「......I can think of a few things, actually.」

0x0035FA.en: 「If Irui and the Custos are connected...@　then the times they saved us...」

0x00367D.en: 「But after the Garden of Baral rose, @　the fish-type Custos bared its fangs at us.」

0x0036EB.en: 「Even so, it opened the way to Meridem Prum for us...」

0x003734.en: 「Only because our interests aligned. @　The Custos side with Baral... they're our enemy.」

0x0037B4.en: 「Are you saying Irui is one of them too?@ When Perfectio unleashed that negative wave,@ Irui gave us courage...」

0x003856.en: 「......Maybe Irui meeting us@　wasn't a coincidence after all.」

0x0038C7.en: 「Then what was it for?@　What was that girl trying to do@　by making contact with us?」

0x00395E.en: 「If Baral really did take Irui away, @　then the reason would be...」

0x0039C3.en: 「Tied to that power she showed us, most likely.」

0x003A09.en: 「And what Irui said about@　'one last thing she could do'...?」

0x003A6B.en: 「......Irui's whereabouts included,@ we've no choice but to see for ourselves.@ By going to the Garden of Baral.」

0x00A70D.en: 「Oh dear, dear... history repeats itself, is that it?」

0x00A772.en: 「Tch, fate's a cruel thing, isn't it?@　And here I was, enjoying the distraction.」

0x00A7D7.en: 「Well, it won't be me carrying out the@　Grand Human Shikai Plan anyway. It's Gan Eden...@　so I'll let you have your moment.」

0x00A8AA.en: 「Fine then. Since you insist,@　let me say a little more!」

0x00A8FD.en: 「I'll open the Gate of Baral for you,@　so throw yourselves on God's mercy!」

0x00A959.en: 「And you'll be given a truly delightful role@　as gods! As mere mortals, mind you,@　not as immortal beings!」

0x00A9DA.en: 「You'll fight on, against all demons and evil!@　Or rather, aren't you already?」

0x00AA39.en: 「Anyway, destroying's so much easier than protecting! Break lives, break worlds, and keep tightening the noose around your own necks!」

0x00AAE4.en: 「Oh, but you're already doing that, aren't you?@　My mistake, my mistake! Hahahahaha!」

0x00AB9B.en: 「Tch, and it was such a nice distraction, too.」

0x00ABD5.en: 「Not bad at all...@　To think common folk could drive the OhRyuKoh into a corner.」

0x00AC2B.en: 「But you know nothing of the Nanboku Immortals.@　Taihoku, use the Art of Iron Will on the OhRyuKoh...」

0x00AC9C.en: 「The BuJakuOh and JakuBuOh sense it too.@　The warping of their own destiny.」

0x00ACF2.en: 「Yet they turned back the great evil, the 'King of Ruin,'@　subdued the Four Fiends and Four Spirits, and stand before us.」

0x00AD7E.en: 「As if you'd understand!@　Would you bring our dearest wish, the Grand Human@　Shikai Plan, to nothing!?」

0x00AE18.en: 「Good grief, fate really is a cruel thing.」

0x00AE52.en: 「My, what a splendidly sore-loser thing to say.」

0x00AE9B.en: 「Tch, a smug bastard right up to the very end.」

0x00AF03.en: 「Abnormal gravity field forming around the ship!@　It's expanding!!」

0x00AF7E.en: 「Kusuha, you've been deceived by the RyuKoOh.@　It's I and my OhRyuKoh who are justice.@　Simply put, you know?」

0x00B017.en: 「I won't be swayed by his words...!@　I believe in the RyuKoOh!」

0x00B076.en: 「And I'll shatter the OhRyuKoh's reverse scale!」

0x00B0B3.en: 「Kusuha, I'll say it as many times as it takes.@　Give yourself over to me. And together, let us@　live out an eternity in paradise.」

0x00B158.en: 「The ones I'll live alongside are Brooklyn and everyone...@　and the RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh!」

0x00B1C6.en: 「I'll never undergo shikai or ascension!@　I'll fight you as a human being!」

0x00B234.en: 「Hm, an unshakable resolve indeed.@　Your experience as a protector is your foundation.@　Well said, well said.」

0x00B2EF.en: 「The OhRyuKoh can't be beaten with the Four Gods' power.@　Well, feel free to try until it's out of your system.」

0x00B360.en: 「I'll surpass whatever rank a Chokijin holds!@ With single-minded resolve, by my will and the KoRyuOh's spirit!!」

0x00B3DD.en: 「What Kusuha truly needs isn't you@　or the KoRyuOh... it's me.」

0x00B445.en: 「Today's the last day for your delusions!」

0x00B479.en: 「It's not a delusion. It's love.@　With my love, Kusuha will bloom all the more beautiful.@　Yes, like a violet in a steep valley.」

0x00B50F.en: 「There's a White Tiger in that valley!@　I won't let you do as you please with Kusuha!」

0x00B56B.en: 「Straight-hearted as ever, I see.@　But that is why you break so easily. Take care.」

0x00B5EB.en: 「Save your concern!@　First, I'll smash that shield of yours to pieces!!」

0x00B647.en: 「Son Ganglong! Though this body perish!@　Though this life run out, I will strike you down!」

0x00B6AF.en: 「...Say that too long and I might just vanish, you know.@　If you want revenge, better make it quick. Hahaha!」

0x00B73E.en: 「Kanan!@　I'll be your puppet no longer!」

0x00B78E.en: 「You'll vanish either way,@　so best have no regrets. Hehehe.」

0x00B7F0.en: 「You turn your blade on us. That too is well.」

0x00B824.en: 「I'll dance in your palm no more!@　Now pay the price for deceiving me!」

0x00B88C.en: 「Even your mighty blade can't cut the OhRyuKoh, you know?」

0x00B8D2.en: 「Then that reverse scale - I'll pierce it, and shatter it!」

0x00B915.en: 「Quite the amusing bit of sophistry! Hahaha!」

0x00B952.en: 「Chokijin of the Vermilion Bird, and Kanan!@ Take my sword, and be burned to nothing by your own flame!」

0x00B9B7.en: 「Heh, before that, with the Black Serpent Blade@　I'll break both your heart and your sword!」

0x00BA10.en: 「One of the Inasato bloodline makes for a fine distraction.@ But I'll show no mercy.」

0x00BA75.en: 「No retreat, no surrender, that is our way!@　And my bloodline, my will, shall cut you in two!」

0x00BAE9.en: 「And yet, for all that,@　the RyuKoOh didn't choose you, did it?」

0x00BB3C.en: 「Even so, I bear the soul-force passed down from my ancestors!@　And I'll carve it into your very flesh!」

0x00BBBF.en: 「A hollow soul with strong will... how unbalanced.」

0x00BBFC.en: 「Well, I can't have you going before my God.@　Die here. I'd best cut down any@　lingering trouble before it grows.」

0x00BCA1.en: 「Lingering trouble...!? What's that supposed to mean!」

0x00BCDE.en: 「Call it hating one's own kind! Hahahaha!」

0x00BD18.en: 「...Captain, this ship and the Hagane@　appear to have returned to normal space.」

0x00BD93.en: 「Confirming position now... but it should be@　nearly the same as where we were. And our@　machines are all still intact.」

0x00BE45.en: 「None so far.@　Only the Garden of Baral lies on our course.」

0x00BEAA.en: 「Units needing repair or resupply, land.@ Maintain full perimeter watch. Once we fix the@ rendezvous sequence, we head to Baral's garden.」
